title: WiseTech says Australian antitrust authorities raided its office, seeking documents and data as part of an alleged competition law breach probe; WTC falls 8%+ (Angus Whitley/Bloomberg)
summary: Angus Whitley / Bloomberg: WiseTech says Australian antitrust authorities raided its office, seeking documents and data as part of an alleged competition law breach probe; WTC falls 8%+ — WiseTech Global Ltd. said Australian antitrust authorities demanded the company hand over documents and data as part of an investigation …
